name: Kayn
source:
Pronouns: He/They
Occupation: Drake

Likes: Attention
Dislikes: Ingenuine people
Hobbies: Trying new food, shopping, avoiding work

Powers: Enhanced Physical Abilities, Fire and Water Control
Signature Technique: Rapid Temperature Control. Kayn has expert control over internal and external temperatures due to the interaction between his fire and water abilities.
Dragon Spring: Fuzanglong

A seemingly high-ranked drake, Kayn is Druk's partner at central. It is said they are an unrivaled duo - their powers and combat techniques a perfect match. A testament to their high rankings, Kayn and Druk were simultaneously able to secure a meeting with Kimura, the head of Central.

Kayn was quick with his advances when you first met. Was that out of pure interest or were there ulterior motives? Surely his flirtations were not necessary to convince you to help, especially given your nature as a healer.

He seems more knowledgeable than he lets on, considering the multitude of ways he has helped you during your time at Central. It's recommended you be wary of the first impression he made.

[From in-game profile]
